## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes. (black -l 160)
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches and my changes comply.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*`. No `area:*` label covers grouped GEMM, so `mod-cutedsl` is used.

## Problem

`gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_gemm_dglu_workspace.py::test_dglu_workspace_device_rejected_before_consumer[wrong_device]` fails on any host with one visible GPU:

```
Expected regex: 'workspace must be'
Actual message: 'cudnn: cuda:1 does not exist (1 device(s) visible)'
```

The test declares the workspace on ordinal `device + 1`, and its comment says this works "even on a single-GPU CI worker". On a single GPU that ordinal does not exist, and `python/cudnn/_device.py` rejects it before the workspace-device check. The call is still rejected before any launch; `seen` stays empty. Only the expected message is stale. CI is unaffected, because its workers see 4 GPUs.

## Change

Test-only. The test accepts either rejection (`workspace must be|does not exist`) and the comment now says why. The "no launch" assertion is unchanged.

## Evidence

`test_grouped_gemm_dglu_workspace.py` on B200, cuDNN 9.26:

| visible GPUs | develop | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `wrong_device` fails | 32 passed |
| 2 | 32 passed | 32 passed |

files.patch:
@@ -26,11 +26,12 @@ def test_dglu_workspace_device_rejected_before_consumer(kind, monkeypatch):
     else:
         storage = torch.empty(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
         # Intercept before any launch: no operation is run on this deliberately
-        # mismatched device declaration, even on a single-GPU CI worker.
+        # mismatched device declaration. With one visible GPU the ordinal does
+        # not exist, which the device resolver rejects first.
         workspace = DeviceView(storage.data_ptr(), (nbytes,), "uint8", storage.device.index + 1)
     seen = []
     monkeypatch.setattr(op._implementation, "_compiled_kernel", lambda *args: seen.append(args))
-    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="workspace must be"):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="workspace must be|does not exist"):
         op.execute(p["a"], p["c"], p["d"], None, None, p["offsets"], p["alpha"], p["beta"], p["prob"], p["dp"], **p["bind"], workspace=workspace)
     assert not seen
